name: slack
description: Send and read Slack messages. Requires a Slack Bot Token (set NLS_SLACK_TOKEN environment variable).

manual.overview: Use Slack when the user or team communicates via Slack and you need to send quick updates, alerts, or threaded discussions. Best for real-time team coordination and channel-based notifications.

examples.description: Post a status update to a channel
Read last 10 messages from a channel by ID
List available channels for the bot

tips: Use channel name (#channel) or channel ID; ID is more reliable if names change
Keep messages concise; Slack is for quick updates, not long-form content
For send, ensure the bot is invited to the channel or it will fail silently
Use list_channels first to discover valid channel targets before sending
edge_cases: Bot token must have chat:write and channels:read scopes; missing scopes cause 403 errors
Private channels require the bot to be explicitly invited; DMs require opening a conversation first
Rate limits apply; rapid sends may be throttled by Slack API
